execution.auto: After a fully settled round is sent, Codex implements the retained tasks. Questions and change requests trigger a revision before execution.
execution.review: This review explores directions. Sending it produces the documents without starting implementation.
summary.readyAutoText: Send this round to finalize PLAN.md and DECISIONS.md. In an active Codex session, the AI then implements the retained tasks without another chat confirmation.

summary.finalizedText: The finalized PLAN.md and DECISIONS.md are available below for reading and download.
